name: cantilever_conv
source: Euler-Bernoulli + Timoshenko tip deflection of the 60x24x12 cantilever at -100 N: 0.5724 + 0.0423 = 0.6147 mm. Fully-integrated Hex8 over-stiffens at coarse pitch — convergence must be monotone toward the reference.
notes: kind=convergence: asserts the error shrinks (within 10%) at every refinement step and the finest pitch lands within tol_rel.
